title: SoftBank invests another $30B in OpenAI

sources.quote: Upon completion of the Follow-on Investment, SBG’s cumulative investment in OpenAI is expected to total USD 64.6 billion, representing an ownership interest of approximately 13%.
Following the Third Tranche Investment, SBG has now completed the USD 30.0 billion follow-on investments in OpenAI previously announced.

explain: In February 2026 SoftBank agreed to put another $30 billion into OpenAI's new funding round, paid in three $10 billion pieces in April, July and October 2026, partly with borrowed money. That brought SoftBank's total OpenAI investment to $64.6 billion for about 13% of the company.
